text:
June (PM): quick sync: drafting a minimal acceptance canvas for routing/isolation features customers can opt into. need concrete gates + owner commitments.
Kai (Eng): sounds good. want to capture: model-variant parity, kv namespace isolation, and bounded batching for latency predictability.
Renee (Infra): infra gates: scheduler label enforcement, egress impact calc, autoscaler response 60s max on 2x. will prototype scheduler hook.
Tom (SRE): ops gates: canary cadence (0.5% 24h -> 5% 72h -> 25% week), alerting on P95/regional delta, tabletop completed. auto-rolloff if error budget > threshold.
Asha (Sales): customers ask for migration windows, transparent fallback behavior, and optional concierge for first reserved customers. also want a short damages/credit blurb.
Law (Legal): will draft pilot vs SLA snippets. need agreed definitions for "fallback" and "outage window" to avoid ambiguity.
June (PM): proposed lanes: shared-soft-isolation, reserved-lane, private-vpc. each lane gets its own acceptance checklist.
Kai (Eng): runtime checklist (pilot): KV hit >=75% steady state, batching tail < target, compatibility tags on model bundles. we should include a simple API header to signal compatibility.
Renee (Infra): placement modes: hard-pin, soft-prefer, no-preference. recommend a guardrail: reserved-lane requires minimum commit (> X GPUs) to protect fragmentation.
Tom (SRE): telemetry: per-tenant token cost, regional P95 heatmap, error budget burn rate. retention: pilot 30d, GA 90d.
Asha (Sales): pricing idea: pilot credit to offset early churn, defined migration window (N hours notice) for cutovers. Sales wants a 1-pager for AEs.
Law (Legal): concierge OK but timeboxed + liability cap. will add migration notice language.
June (PM): unblock items: Kai spike on KV warmup + model stitch tests (2w), Renee egress delta + scheduler shim (2w), Tom canary playbook + dashboard mock (1w), Law/Asha draft contract blips (1w).
RoadieBot: task created PLAT-6010 "islands-acceptance-canvas" assigned to June. Weekly sync Tue 10:00.
Kai (Eng): i'll also run a small replay to validate batching vs latency under mixed-tenancy.
Renee (Infra): will model egress costs across 3 clouds and include delta per 1M tokens.
Tom (SRE): will add automatic rollback policy: local fallback -> alternate region -> mark tenant impacted after grace period.
June (PM): please post 2-sentence owner plans by Thu so i can fold into the stakeholder slide. i'll publish the gating matrix after that. thanks everyone. :rocket:
